body:
**VSMCP-DiscordStatus** is a lightweight Minecraft plugin that automatically posts server details (like name, IP, platform, player count, status, and whitelist status) directly to your Discord channel using a Discord bot.

Developed by Vectorize Studios.
**Join Discord** : https://discord.gg/pHgdFJprcd  

## Installation
- Download the latest release:
- VSMCP-DiscordStatus.jar
- Place it in your server’s /plugins/ folder.
- Start your server — required libraries will auto-download.
- A config.yml file will be generated.
- Edit the config to add:
- Bot Token
- ️Server Name
- Server IP
- Platform (Java/Bedrock)
- ️Logo / Banner URL
- Restart your server → Done ✅
